summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by TOP Financial Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on May 27, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$1M to US$20M, adoption of amended articles of association, and a share consolidation within a 1-for-2 to 1-for-20 range at the board's discretion. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing is a routine capital structure adjustment and not a special situation.
